rows.context_and_review_note: Retained ⵓⵏⵣⵉⵖ. Independently verified IRCAM dictionary search excerpt explicitly pairing this spelling with rectangle, printed p.134 (https://www.ircam.ma/sites/default/files/2021-02/amz_fr_ar.pdf; same text https://biblio.ircam.ma/pmb/uploads/publications/177.pdf). The direct PDF fetch returned HTTP 502, but the indexed primary-source excerpt is unambiguous. Exact-base PaintTool.RECTANGLE resolves this label; PaintCanvas.shapePath builds addRect(bounds(),CW), then PaintDocument.drawShape strokes/fills the path according to the current shape style. It is an ordinary rectangle, not rounded rectangle, square-only geometry or a selection operation. Five Tifinagh letters; no placeholders.

rows.backtranslation: Selection with a rectangle / rectangular selection
rows.context_and_review_note: Retained ⴰⵙⵜⵉ ⵙ ⵡⵓⵏⵣⵉⵖ: selection with a rectangle. The annexed form after ⵙ follows the u-initial noun pattern. IRCAM grammatical vocabulary independently attests the same spelling pair ⵓⵏⵣⵉⵖ / ⵡⵓⵏⵣⵉⵖ for a homonym (https://biblio.ircam.ma/pmb/uploads/publications/134.pdf); this supports morphology only, not geometric meaning, which is separately attested in the dictionary. Exact-base SELECT uses this label and document.select(bounds()) with default null mask, unlike LASSO passing a traced mask. select intersects the rectangular bounds with the image and extracts its pixels. ToolButton uses both labels for visible text, contentDescription and tooltip. This three-word label distinguishes selecting a region from drawing a rectangle. Its 13 characters including spaces are compact, but no actual rendering or large-font fit test was run.
